text.p: Headlines from major national newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
EL PAIS
- Hong Kong handover to China, with a promise to preserve its freedom.
- IU takes out of its statute any reference to Catalan partners.
- Andalusian PSOE calls primary elections to nominate condidates.
EL MUNDO
- (Ex financier) De la Rosa pressures (PMU) Aznar and (his main ally CiU's leader) Pujol with documents saying he gave money both to Popular Party and CiU.
CINCO DIAS
- Iberia to will end up in a euro-american merger triangle.
- Political pressure over KIO to sell its 39 percent stake in Ebro.
- Economy Minister is studying the possibility of hiking VAT next January (in a way to compensate possible income tax reductions).
EXPANSION
- Average yield of investment funds is above 28 percent
- Industry Ministry to abolish the freezing of butane gas prices after Repsol's appeal.
- IBM to promote joint venture between banks and saving banks for to adopt a common sotfware.
GACETA DE LOS NEGOCIOS
- Spanish government wants Kio to sell its 39 percent stake in Ebro to domestic saving banks in a way to keep Spanish control over the sugar company
- Santander, BBV and BCH control already 21 percent of Sol Melia.
- (The shadow economy minister) PSOE's Eguiagaray - Public deficit not sure of ramaining under control
- Trade union UGT asks for wage increases above CPI for public servants
-- Madrid newsroom, + 341 5858.340
